name: Feature request

title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement

## Problem

What concrete problem should this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected user-facing behavior or API behavior.

## Scope check

Confirm the proposal keeps SkillTopo within its project scope:

- [ ] It does not turn SkillTopo into a full agent framework.
- [ ] It does not make semantic matching a required dependency.
- [ ] It does not execute skills or grant permissions.
- [ ] It does not require private skill libraries, private paths, credentials, or proprietary prompts.

## Example

Use synthetic metadata, queries, or evaluation cases.

```yaml
query: "code crashed"
expected: systematic-debugging
```

## Alternatives considered

List any simpler alternatives, including documentation-only changes.
